facts: EU AI Act entered into force 2024-08-01; general application 2026-08-02.
Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744) in force 2026-07-27: high-risk obligations moved to 2027-12-02 and 2028-08-02.
GPAI models placed on the market before 2026-08-02 must comply by 2027-08-02.
Prohibited-practices bans and AI-literacy duties apply since 2025-02-02.
use: automation_audit attaches this watch (as-of dated) to every deployment design; Sentinel's AI-security review cross-checks it.
